description: Nhóm Nasa 8 trường THCS Vĩnh Trại
summary:
**Abandoned but Not Forgotten** is an interactive storytelling website that explores the history of spacecraft and scientific equipment left behind after their missions in space. Through the journey of Kiet and Astra, visitors discover real NASA missions, including Apollo 11, Spirit and Opportunity, Ingenuity, Dawn, and Pioneer 10 and 11.

The website combines scientific facts, historical information, images, and creative storytelling to make space exploration more engaging and accessible. It helps visitors understand that even when a spacecraft stops working, its discoveries continue to contribute to science and inspire future generations.

Our mission is to honor these forgotten explorers and remind the world that their contributions will never be lost.
details: Team Nasa 8 - Vt8 proudly presents our project for Challenge 1, titled "Abandoned But Not Forgotten: A Journey Through Space and the Souls of Science." Created by team members Nguyễn Gia Kiệt, Trần Quỳnh Anh, Đào Anh Kiệt, Nguyễn Tuấn Kiệt, Nghiêm Đình Kiên, and Phan Minh Hằng, this interactive storytelling web exhibition explores the profound history of legendary spacecraft—such as Eagle, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Ingenuity, Dawn, and the Pioneer missions—that completed their missions and remain forever in the cosmos. Featuring a cinematic holographic design, authentic NASA archival imagery, ambient space soundscapes, and engaging character dialogues, our platform honors these silent explorers and celebrates the enduring legacy of human discovery.
